comment: Golden vectors for runtime liveness at v 2, under firmware-commands/v2 Runtime Liveness at v 2. A device must accept every case in 'cases', leaving the held nonce its 'expected_held_nonce' gives, and refuse every case in 'reject_cases', 'precedence_cases' and 'transport_reject_cases' with the declared reason, leaving the held nonce unchanged. Each case is evaluated against its own verifier_context. Signed with the TEST-ONLY runtime and rogue seeds of the v1 liveness corpus; never use them in production. Nonces are fixed fixture values; a runtime draws its own from a cryptographically secure source. Each rollout sequence is a run of deliveries to one device that accepts the listed versions, starting from its verifier_context; each delivery gives its reason, null when accepted, and the device state after it.

reasons.malformed: the message violates the fixed grammar of its v
reasons.signature_invalid: the signature does not verify against the runtime key
reasons.boot_mismatch: boot_id is not the device's current boot
reasons.capability_hash_mismatch: capability_hash is not the accepted manifest hash
reasons.seq_not_increasing: runtime_seq does not exceed the last accepted in this boot

cases.name: liveness_v2_first_after_boot
cases.note: the first liveness of a boot sets the held nonce

cases.name: liveness_v2_replaces_held_nonce
cases.note: a later v 2 message replaces the held nonce

cases.name: liveness_v1_clears_held_nonce
cases.note: an accepted v 1 message clears the held nonce; v1's grammar is unchanged

cases.name: liveness_v2_after_v1
cases.note: one high-water mark serves both versions; 4 exceeds the v 1 message's 3

cases.name: liveness_v2_after_sequence_gap
cases.note: a gap in runtime_seq is accepted, as in v1

cases.name: liveness_v2_all_zero_nonce
cases.note: the grammar admits any 32 lowercase hex digits; a device does not judge randomness

reject_cases.name: reject_v2_missing_nonce
reject_cases.note: v 2 requires nonce

reject_cases.name: reject_v1_with_nonce
reject_cases.note: v 1 has v1's grammar exactly; nonce is an extra field there

reject_cases.name: reject_v2_nonce_uppercase
reject_cases.note: hex digits are lowercase only

reject_cases.name: reject_v2_nonce_non_hex
reject_cases.note: g is not a hexadecimal digit

reject_cases.name: reject_v2_nonce_31_chars
reject_cases.note: exactly 32 characters

reject_cases.name: reject_v2_nonce_33_chars
reject_cases.note: exactly 32 characters

reject_cases.name: reject_v2_nonce_empty
reject_cases.note: the empty string is not 32 characters

reject_cases.name: reject_v2_nonce_null
reject_cases.note: a v 2 message always carries a nonce; null is the envelope's spelling for none held, never liveness's

reject_cases.name: reject_v2_nonce_integer
reject_cases.note: nonce is a JSON string

reject_cases.name: reject_v2_nonce_boolean
reject_cases.note: nonce is a JSON string; true is a boolean

reject_cases.name: reject_v2_extra_field
reject_cases.note: a key outside the v 2 grammar, in canonical position; there is deliberately no TTL field

reject_cases.name: reject_v2_nonce_out_of_order
reject_cases.note: nonce sits between device_id and runtime_seq in canonical order; the signature is valid over these exact bytes

reject_cases.name: reject_unsupported_version
reject_cases.note: only v 1 and v 2 are defined

reject_cases.name: reject_v2_replayed_exact_bytes
reject_cases.note: byte-identical to liveness_v2_replaces_held_nonce, which the device already accepted, replayed: equal is not above

reject_cases.name: reject_v2_regressing_runtime_seq
reject_cases.note: a lower runtime_seq is refused

reject_cases.name: reject_v2_reissued_runtime_seq_fresh_nonce
reject_cases.note: a runtime whose state store was restored reissues runtime_seq 2 under a fresh nonce; the device refuses it and keeps the nonce it holds, so readings it signs still carry the earlier nonce

reject_cases.name: reject_v2_same_seq_as_accepted_v1
reject_cases.note: one high-water mark serves both versions: 3 was accepted at v 1

reject_cases.name: reject_v1_same_seq_as_accepted_v2
reject_cases.note: and the reverse: 2 was accepted at v 2

reject_cases.name: reject_v2_wrong_device
reject_cases.note: signed for another device

reject_cases.name: reject_v2_wrong_boot
reject_cases.note: signed for an earlier boot

reject_cases.name: reject_v2_manifest_mismatch
reject_cases.note: signed for another manifest

reject_cases.name: reject_v2_rogue_key
reject_cases.note: signed by a key the device does not hold

precedence_cases.name: reject_malformed_before_device
precedence_cases.note: a v 2 message without nonce, for another device: grammar is checked first

precedence_cases.name: reject_device_before_signature
precedence_cases.note: for another device and signed by a rogue key: the device is checked first

precedence_cases.name: reject_signature_before_boot
precedence_cases.note: a rogue key and an earlier boot: the signature is checked first

precedence_cases.name: reject_boot_before_manifest
precedence_cases.note: an earlier boot and another manifest: the boot is checked first

precedence_cases.name: reject_manifest_before_seq
precedence_cases.note: another manifest and a replayed runtime_seq: the manifest is checked first

transport_reject_cases.name: reject_v2_retained_delivery
transport_reject_cases.note: byte-identical to a v 2 message the device must accept when delivered live

transport_reject_cases.name: reject_retained_before_malformed
transport_reject_cases.note: a retained delivery of a v 2 message without nonce: delivery is decided before content

rollout_sequences.name: rollout_v1_only_device_stays_supervised
rollout_sequences.note: a device that implements only v 1 accepts every v 1 message and refuses every v 2 message as malformed: it stays supervised and never holds a nonce

rollout_sequences.name: rollout_v2_device_ends_holding_v2_nonce
rollout_sequences.note: each pair clears the held nonce and then sets it; the device ends holding the last v 2 nonce

rollout_sequences.name: rollout_between_pair_holds_none
rollout_sequences.note: after the next interval's v 1 message and before its v 2 message the device holds none

rollout_sequences.name: rollout_reordered_pair_keeps_v2_nonce
rollout_sequences.note: the v 2 message arrives first and is accepted; the v 1 message is then refused as seq_not_increasing and changes nothing, so the device keeps a nonce whose signing still precedes everything it measures afterwards

rollout_sequences.name: rollout_v1_missing
rollout_sequences.note: only the v 2 message arrives: the device holds its nonce

rollout_sequences.name: rollout_v2_missing
rollout_sequences.note: only the v 1 message arrives: the device is supervised and holds none
